reports.title: THE BANCORP REPORTS 3Q 2026 EPS OF $1.53, ROA OF 2.51%, AND ROE OF 36.0%

lines: We are maintaining Core EPS(1) guidance in the range of $5.95 - $6.05 a share for 2026(2), and providing a Core EPS(1) baseline range of $7.00 - $7.20 a share for 2027.
In addition, we are initiating preliminary Core EPS(1) guidance for 2028 of $8.00 - $8.20 a share.
We expect to repurchase $200 million of shares in 2026, or $50 million a quarter.

We expect to continue to invest in tax credits in future periods, resulting in an estimated annual future effective tax rate of approximately 23.9%, compared to the full year 2025 effective tax rate of 24.7%.
